title: Law to require study of electrical capacity in older buildings
summary: This bill would require the Department of Buildings, working with FDNY and HPD, to study the electrical capacity of at least 500 older residential buildings (multiple dwellings under 50,000 square feet built before 1976) every five years. The goal is to identify buildings that need electrical panel upgrades to reduce fire risk. Results would be reported to the mayor and Council Speaker and posted on the Buildings Department website.
